pages.text: Over the deep frozen ocean lies the $(l)Ice Maze$(), a graveyard of pirate ships.

Take a Shell Horn from a pirate captain and blow it near open water to call up the $(l)Ghost of Captain Cornelia$(). Her $(l:bosses/aquamirae#frozen_key)Frozen Key$(/l) opens a chest in a shelter below.$(br2)The Maze Mother hunts near the anglerfish. The Shipbreaker can't be beaten. Run.
